metrics.label: Active days
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress log --format=%as ff5ff42 | sort -u | wc -l

metrics.label: Commits on origin/dev at b0f0b94 (integration branch)
Versions recorded in plugins/gs-fortress/CHANGELOG.md
metrics.note: more than this repo's tags: the changelog may predate its history

metrics.label: Lines of JavaScript/TypeScript, excluding tests
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress grep -I -c '' ff5ff42 -- '*.mjs' '*.cjs' '*.js' '*.ts' '*.tsx' | awk -F: '$2 !~ "(^|/)(tests?|__tests__)/|\\.test\\.[a-z]+$|_test\\.[a-z]+$|(^|/)test_[^/]*\\.py$|(^|/)test-[^/]*\\.(mjs|js|sh)$" {s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: Lines of JavaScript/TypeScript in test files
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress grep -I -c '' ff5ff42 -- '*.mjs' '*.cjs' '*.js' '*.ts' '*.tsx' | awk -F: '$2 ~ "(^|/)(tests?|__tests__)/|\\.test\\.[a-z]+$|_test\\.[a-z]+$|(^|/)test_[^/]*\\.py$|(^|/)test-[^/]*\\.(mjs|js|sh)$" {s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: Lines of Markdown (docs, skills, ledgers)
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress grep -I -c '' ff5ff42 -- '*.md' | awk -F: '{s+=$NF} END {print s+0}'

metrics.label: Commit authors other than the owner (count only)
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress log --format=%aN ff5ff42 | sort -u | grep -vixF -e 'bradleydb' -e 'bradley' | wc -l

metrics.label: dev-loop findings on the bus, live + archive
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress show ff5ff42:dev/FEEDBACK.md ff5ff42:dev/FEEDBACK-archive.md | grep -oE '^## F-[0-9]+' | sort -u | wc -l

metrics.label: Impact-checklist items at the first audit (b9b6d3a, 2026-07-27)
Upstream releases audited (audit reports)
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress ls-tree --name-only ff5ff42 ledger/reports/ | grep -cE '/audit-[0-9.]+\.md$'

metrics.label: Build-kickoff files (change plans handed to build sessions)
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress ls-tree --name-only ff5ff42 ledger/reports/ | grep -cE '/build-kickoffs-[0-9.]+\.md$'

metrics.label: Vendor-ready defect reports on file
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress ls-tree --name-only ff5ff42 ledger/upstream-feedback/reports/ | grep -c '\.md$'

metrics.label: Resolved defects that had a report on file
Tracked defects carrying the 2026-07-30 vendor reply
Bus findings reopened at least once (by a tester or the owner)
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress show ff5ff42:dev/FEEDBACK.md ff5ff42:dev/FEEDBACK-archive.md | awk '/^## F-[0-9]+/{f=$2} /^Reopened/{print f}' | sort -u | wc -l

metrics.label: Test suites (*.test.mjs)
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress ls-tree -r --name-only ff5ff42 plugins/gs-fortress/test | grep -cE '\.test\.mjs$'

metrics.label: Watcher invariants restated to every agent
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress show ff5ff42:plugins/gs-fortress/skills/gs-admin-cli-watch/SKILL.md | sed -n '/^## Invariants/,/^## Stage 0/p' | grep -cE '^[0-9]+\. '

metrics.label: Build kickoffs written as handoff-plan sets (session map, frozen contracts)
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress grep -l '^## Session map' ff5ff42 -- ledger/reports/ | wc -l

metrics.label: Frozen contracts in the 1.0.10 build plan
metrics.command: git -C gs-fortress show ff5ff42:ledger/reports/build-kickoffs-1.0.10.md | awk '/^## Frozen contracts/{f=1;next} /^## /{f=0} f && /^- /' | wc -l

metrics.label: Merged pull requests
metrics.command: gh pr list -R BradleyDB/gs-fortress --state merged --limit 2000 --json number --jq length

metrics.label: Merged PRs by someone other than the owner (count only)
metrics.command: gh pr list -R BradleyDB/gs-fortress --state merged --limit 2000 --json author --jq '[.[] | select(.author.login != "BradleyDB")] | length'
